# Rules (always apply)
App: permutations of 1..n, n in 1..20, .NET 8 API + Angular 20 (standalone, signals, OnPush, strict). UI Hebrew RTL. Order: lexicographic ascending.
Style: be terse. No explanations, don't reprint files, final report max 6 lines. Never ask questions: decide, and add 1 line to README "Design Decisions". Do NOT run terminal commands (build, test, dotnet, ng, npm, git). I run them myself and paste you only the failures. Just write the code and finish.
Hard rules: all computation on server; NEVER precompute all permutations; no static mutable state; no TODOs/dead code.
Projects exist already: src/{Domain,Application,Infrastructure,Api}, tests/{Domain,Application,Api}.Tests, client/. Dependencies: Domain <- Application <- Infrastructure; Api -> Application+Infrastructure.
Domain: pure stateless thread-safe classes behind interfaces. Factorial table 0..20 as ulong (checked; n>20 throws). NextPermutation(int[]) in place -> bool. Unrank(ulong zeroBasedIndex, int n) -> int[] (factorial number system). Rank(int[]) -> ulong.
Session: StartAPI creates session (GUID) and returns sessionId; client sends header X-Session-Id on every call. State: n, total, lastShownIndex (1-based, 0=none), current int[], allStart (1-based, fixed when entering all-view). ISessionStore in Application; in-memory impl in Infrastructure (ConcurrentDictionary, sliding expiry, max sessions, per-session SemaphoreSlim, atomic update), options via IOptions/appsettings.
API /api/combinations (names map to StartAPI/GetNextAPI/GetAllAPI): POST start {n} -> {sessionId,total}; POST next -> {hasMore,index,permutation,message}; GET all?pageSize&page&enter -> {items:[{index,permutation}],page,totalPages,startIndex,total}; enter=true fixes allStart=lastShownIndex+1, later calls reuse it; pages are relative to allStart; after each page lastShownIndex=last index returned and current array synced via Unrank; GET current -> last shown or empty; DELETE -> reset.
All large numbers (total,index,totalPages,page) are JSON STRINGS (exceed JS safe integer); client uses BigInt only. Permutation elements are plain numbers.
Validation + ProblemDetails: n int 1..20 else 400; pageSize 1..100 (default 20); page 1..totalPages; missing/unknown/expired session -> 404. Next after last -> 200 {hasMore:false,message:"אין יותר קומבינציות"}, state unchanged on repeats. All with nothing left -> 200 empty items + same message. Global exception middleware, CORS for localhost:4200, Swagger, logging.
Hebrew UI texts: "סה"כ האפשרויות לסדר n מספרים בשורה הוא: X" (X with thousands separators), buttons "איפוס" "הבא" "כל הקומבינציות" "חזור", "קומבינציה מספר 1 – [1,2,3]". Render permutations in dir="ltr".
